text:
Jamal Reed: Heads-up  final on-site for candidate Samir Kapoor Tue 10:00am PT. Two unusual asks: hes driving a rental EV and asked whether we have EV charging on campus, and HR needs to confirm pre-onboarding background check form completion before arrival. Also asked about vegetarian + nut allergy lunch. Can ppl confirm?

Priya Rao: Im on the panel 10-11:30 and can be remote if needed. I can follow up with Samir about the background form.

people-ops: We require background check authorization to be completed at least 48 hours before the on-site for offers to proceed; please send the background link ASAP. We can also accept screenshots of the confirmation email. For dietary note, we will order vegetarian, nut-free boxed lunch and mark it as allergy-safe.

Jamal Reed: Thanks. @facilities any EV charger availability and how long it takes to reserve? Hed prefer top-up while onsite.

facilities: We have two Level 2 chargers in Lot C and one Level 2 in the Visitor Garage. We can reserve one charger for a 3-hour window; reservation needs the EV plate number or rental agreement. If candidate needs faster charging (DC fast), nearest public station is 8 mins away; we can prepay a voucher if needed.

Priya Rao: Samir said hes driving a Tesla rental (plate ends 7XZ). I can DM the full rental agreement if needed. If we reserve Lot C charger for 9:30-12:30 that should cover his visit.

security: For EV charger reservation we need the plate and a copy of the rental agreement on file. Also note: vendors require a signed visitor NDA if they access staging. Does Samir need access to staging for the take-home or live exercise?

Jamal Reed: Good catch. The exercise uses a staging sandbox but no sensitive data; we prefer he uses the staging account mg.samir+candidate@redwood.ai with limited perms. people-ops can create a temp account and attach NDA at reception.

people-ops: Will do. Creating staging account and will print NDA to sign. Also sending the background-check link to Samir right now and will monitor completion. Reserving Lot C charger 9:30-12:30 for plate *7XZ and flagging Reception to escort him to the charger if needed. Adding dietary note to the packet.

Priya Rao: One more ask  Samir prefers pair-programming in VS Code Live Share for collaboration. Can we ensure the staging laptop loaner has VS Code + Live Share extension and that network allows the Live Share session?

people-ops: Yes  laptop LOAN-3344 will be provisioned with macOS dev image, VS Code, Live Share, Node, and Docker. Network allows Live Share; well whitelist any necessary outbound ports.

Jamal Reed: Recruiter, please confirm that background check is done by Mon EOD otherwise we shift to remote loop. Also if the charger reservation falls through, fallback plan is to provide a pre-paid DC fast voucher and directions to the nearest station.

recruiter-bot: Calendar event created: "Samir Kapoor  Onsite Final" Tue 10:00-11:45 PT. Background-check link and EV charger reservation attached.

facilities: Charger reserved. If candidate needs the pre-paid fast-charging voucher we will email a voucher code and directions.

people-ops: Background-check link sent to candidate at 1881234600. We'll notify this channel when confirmation arrives. Packet printed with NDA, charger directions, parking validation, and allergy-safe lunch.

Priya Rao: Great coordination. If background not confirmed by Mon 5pm, I'll switch to remote for the loop.

Jamal Reed: Thanks everyone  closing loop unless we see any outstanding items. :thumbsup:
